fns.desc: In eap_server_tls_build_msg, if data->tls_out_limit (from admin-configured fragment_size) is <=4, 'send_len -= 4' at the LENGTH_INCLUDED branch can underflow a size_t, producing a huge send_len passed to wpabuf_put_data and overreading data->tls_out. Config-gated (fragment_size), not remotely attacker-triggerable, so low practical severity.
